question:
Given below are two sets of numbers. Both the sets are formed using the same mathematical equations or follow a common pattern. Which of the given options follows the same set of mathematical equations or patterns as the sets given in the question?

4-9-25-64-169; 16-49-121-324-841
solution:
The logic followed here is:

​4 - 9 - 25 - 64 - 169 → ​2² - 32 - 52 - 82 - 132

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bc75cb2c69acddf3d53744d734ee69ab0268b7ad4739dffb3af11a60cb51884.png] 

And,

16 - 49 - 121 - 324 - 841 → ​42 - 72 - 112 - 182 - 292​​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/094c9d6547d3f52fa2c0ee14fd938039325ead3f0a9a1420d3b6c1772eb66379.png] 

Similarly,

64 - 225 - 529 - 1444 - 3721 → 82 - 152 - 232 - 382 - 612

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab02499915a3c8b51f90422ef51f541f6bce9263f3de3a9c73744c2bba275629.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
